summary: audio_complete trusts the client and records end_reason=all_covered with zero coverage; unauthenticated candidate can force-end a session and trigger portfolio generation on an empty interview
save_skills is non-transactional: invalid 2nd skill leaves the 1st row persisted with portfolio generation_status=failed (partial portfolio readable)

Fit/gap contract drift: engine persists expected_level and never emits is_override, web reads required_level/is_override, so the Required column is always blank and the override marker can never render
Login fallback SELECT scheme FROM organizations LIMIT 1 has no ORDER BY and no id!=0: with the reserved id=0 org physically first it binds the reserved default org (wrong tenant on every token)
Invalid or expired invite 404 is shown to the candidate as 'Interview Complete ... has been recorded'; candidate believes a real interview happened while assessors see nothing
No Sidekiq worker in the compose stack: all perform_async jobs stay queued, portfolio stuck generating, fit/gap and export unreachable in the reviewed delivery environment
Tenant selection is client-controlled at login (X-Tenant-Scheme) with no user-to-org binding; any authenticated admin can mint a valid token scoped to any existing org (cross-tenant data integrity)
Confidence rules (high/medium/low from probe_count and state) are prompt-only; save_skills persists LLM output verbatim so a probe_count=1 skill can store confidence=high
Fit/gap skill matching is exact-case skill_id then exact label; realistic lowercase ids silently degrade to not_assessed and hide real gaps
Web status union omits 'failed' and portfolio union omits the failed-shape 'error' key: a failed session renders no chip and no action
skill_id typed number vs varchar sk-eng-001; SkillCard prefixes again so badges render SK-sk-eng-001
Wrong password on /login hits the global 401 interceptor which reloads the page already shown; error state discarded, no message ever displayed
JWT decoded without verification as a tenant hint: protected routes still 401, but Current.organization is set from unverified claims for the rest of the request (hardening, no exploit proven)
Vacancy with zero skills makes fit/gap raise RecordInvalid (skill comparisons blank) and surface a 500 instead of an empty-but-valid report
Discovered-skill line renders raw integer '3 (confirmed)' instead of 'L3'; everything else tolerates both shapes
Three indexes on coverage_maps.session_id (unique composite plus two redundant single-column indexes)
.irbrc filters discarded_at IS NULL but the column does not exist; console helper always errors and mint falls back to scheme unknown
Assessment create/update returns system_prompt_generated:true synchronously while the generator runs async (and never runs without a worker); the flag is a constant, not a fact
